title: Export a part as STL for printing
summary: Check the part is one sound solid, select it, and export it as an STL mesh a slicer reads.

steps.say: First make sure the part is one sound solid: a slicer needs a closed shape.
steps.explain: An STL is only triangles. If the solid has a gap or two pieces, the mesh will too, and the print may fail.

steps.say: Click **Body** in the tree to select it.
hints: It is in the Model tab, on the left.

steps.say: Choose **File › Export**, pick **STL Mesh** as the type, and save it as Part.stl.
steps.explain: Export writes only what is selected. STL is the mesh format every slicer reads.
hints: Export is in the File menu, under Save.
In the dialog, set the file type to STL Mesh.
